summary: [standards] The failure path of atip.codenames.02 (a source that builds an old name fails the registry-match test) is proved by asserting that grammar_t5_errors.rs contains the text of a test name, not by making the test fail. Also every_code_a_source_builds_is_registered scans the needles CliError::refused(", CliError::failed(", refused(" and failed(" only, so a call through the helper refuse(" (brief_approve.rs raises BRIEF_INVALID that way) is not matched against the registry. The old-names guard (old_names.rs) and the emission tests still cover those sites. Blast radius: a typo in a refuse(...) call site is caught only by an emission test of that code.
